purpose: Code's eval authority ask (POST /v1/product/eval/authority) sends approver {personId, provider} as the identity adapter names the approver (Principal.personId, Principal.provider), NOT as a developer id. Cloud converts that pair to Code's developer id with the derivation below before comparing it with its stored approval.
derivation: lowercase hex of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of: "developer" + U+0000 + provider + U+0000 + personId
